supported_mechanisms.capability: Beds24 can redirect the guest after the booking confirmation step to a first-party AUMARA return endpoint. AUMARA must configure that return without guest PII in the URL.
Beds24 Auto Actions can run webhooks or HTTP POST notifications using booking trigger conditions and template variables.
supported_mechanisms.timing_note: Auto Actions are batch processed and are not a strict real-time browser signal.

recommended_contract.browser_return: Point the Beds24 Booking Return URL to an untagged AUMARA server endpoint. That endpoint may accept only allowlisted opaque non-PII state, then must issue a server-side redirect to a clean first-party success URL with no query string before any Google tag renders.
recommended_contract.server_signal: Use a Beds24 Auto Action webhook as the authoritative validation/reconciliation signal when configured.
recommended_contract.privacy: Do not send guest name, email, phone, address, free-text guest fields or other direct identifiers in return URLs or Google Ads/GA4 conversion events.

release_gate: Implement and verify the untagged AUMARA return endpoint with an allowlisted non-PII query and server-side redirect to a clean success URL, or use the webhook-only path.
Create or resolve a completed-booking Google Ads conversion action, or resolve an already-linked GA4 key event.
Prove one real successful direct booking end-to-end with transaction deduplication before enabling conversion-based bidding.
